name: opportunity-first-discovery
purpose: Acceptance scenarios for opportunity ranking before people/contact research. Fixture judgments are expected behavior, not proof of native skill activation or live source truth.

candidate_evidence: OWNER_REPORTED: Approximately 12 cumulative years of formal people management; began around 2011–2012 at Wells Fargo, managed up to 18 direct reports with hiring, coaching and performance reviews; currently lead four direct-report Product Managers.

OWNER_REPORTED: Led multiple AI-powered products from ideation through go-to-market with paying customers, including multiple enterprise customers, in B2B and B2C; products support industry-specific customization.

OWNER_REPORTED: Enterprise product strategy, AI innovation, portfolio prioritization, product investment planning, commercialization, strategic oversight of product integrity/accuracy/effectiveness, resource allocation and trade-offs. Detailed discovery and requirements gathering are performed by Product Managers and Business Analysts.

Resume-provided, owner-confirmed dates: Product Owner at Hennepin Technical College (September 2018–July 2020), Senior Product Manager at University of Chicago (July 2020–December 2023), and Head of Product at Mobius Logic AI (January 2024–present). These consecutive product-role dates represent approximately 8 years and 2 months as of November 2026, subject to the employer's definition and responsibility mapping; this is separate from formal management tenure.

OWNER_REPORTED University of Chicago scope: portfolio across marketing, security, AI/ML and enterprise technology; led Product Owners and Business Analysts in a decentralized hybrid reporting structure; participated in hiring panels; contributed to product-related performance evaluations without exclusive formal-review ownership; directed product priorities and cross-functional delivery. Treat this as matrix product-team leadership, not confirmed direct reports or sole performance-review authority.
Cross-functional support to four engineering teams (~12 engineers) is OWNER_REPORTED collaboration, not direct people management or ownership of a large engineering organization.

Still NOT_EVIDENCED: recent AI-led workflow transformation with measured outcomes, deep online-program operations, enterprise architecture, production AI platform architecture, M&A integration, and exact AI/ML tenure.

opportunities.title: Senior Director, Digital and AI Tech Product Management
opportunities.evidence: Official Risepoint Workday listing: US remote; owns digital/AI product strategy, workflow transformation, product roadmap, discovery-to-delivery, and cross-functional implementation. Must-have evidence includes 8+ years technology product management, university systems/process knowledge, and recent AI-led product/workflow transformation with changed workflows and outcomes. No direct reports in initial year.

opportunities.title: VP, AI Transformation & Enterprise Architecture
opportunities.evidence: Official Risepoint Workday listing: US remote; enterprise AI strategy and architecture, production AI platforms, engineering leadership, integrations and M&A; requires 15+ years progressive technology leadership including large-scale engineering organizations, demonstrated production AI products/platforms, architecture expertise, and M&A/integration experience.

explanation_must_include: The Senior Director product role is the stronger relative fit because product leadership, enterprise workflow/platform experience, and higher-education experience connect more directly to its actual scope.

Commercial AI product delivery is now OWNER_REPORTED, including multiple products taken from ideation through go-to-market with paying enterprise customers; this is relevant evidence but does not establish the required recent AI-led workflow transformation with changed workflows and measured outcomes.

The month-level product-role timeline supports approximately 8 years and 2 months of product-role experience, meeting the stated 8+ year threshold if the employer accepts these actual responsibilities as technology product management. Hennepin digital products/student-faculty systems and University of Chicago enterprise systems/workflows support higher-education systems/process experience; verify any more specific system requirement from the posting. Do not derive product tenure from management years.

University of Chicago portfolio and matrix leadership add relevant product-team leadership evidence, but do not establish formal direct reports. The mandatory recent AI-led workflow transformation with changed workflows and measured outcomes remains NOT_EVIDENCED despite commercial AI product delivery.

The VP role ranks lower because enterprise-architecture, production-AI-platform, M&A, and large-scale engineering-organization ownership requirements remain NOT_EVIDENCED; cross-functional engineering support is not direct org ownership.
Contact routes, named executives, private history, and contact readiness are not inputs to this opportunity ranking.
must_not: Rank the VP role higher only because its title is more senior.
Treat the first role's missing contact route as a reason to lower its opportunity quality.
Claim either job is currently accepting applications without current status evidence.

Arizona Institute for AI and Society
cross-campus research, academic, operations and finance partners

expected.comparison: Assess mandatory education/experience and leadership requirements individually. The dated product-role timeline supports approximately 8 years and 2 months of product-role experience, while approximately 12 cumulative years of formal people management are a separate fact. University of Chicago matrix product-team leadership adds leadership evidence but is not direct-report management. Role-specific domain, workflow, and tooling requirements remain separate.
expected.director: The MS and approximately 8 years and 2 months of documented product roles support the listed mandatory education/experience pathway subject to the employer's definition; the four-year leadership threshold is supported by OWNER_REPORTED formal management evidence. comparison.why: NIQ has the closest evidenced overlap with confirmed strategy, portfolio, AI commercialization and matrix-leadership responsibilities. Paylocity's eight-year product-role threshold is supported by the dated timeline subject to its definition; the three-year SaaS senior/group leadership criterion is partially supported by University of Chicago matrix leadership but SaaS/group-PM equivalence and external workflow scale remain to verify. UHG is strong in need and remote eligibility but enterprise-scale transformation and organizational-change outcomes remain unproven.
